name: First orbiter at Mars
description: The Program has its first spacecraft in orbit around Mars, and the world is watching.

name: First landing on Mars
description: The Program has put a working spacecraft on the surface of Mars, and the pictures are on every front page.

name: First rover on Mars
description: The Program has a rover driving on Mars, and people everywhere are following where it goes next.

name: 500 Science earned
description: The Program has earned 500 Science, and its first results are in the news as well as the journals.

name: 1000 Science earned
description: The Program has earned 1000 Science, and schools and museums everywhere are teaching what it found.

name: 1500 Science earned
description: The Program has earned 1500 Science, and it has changed what people think they know about Mars.

name: 2000 Science earned
description: The Program has earned 2000 Science, and its discoveries are now the reason people give for going to Mars.

name: 2250 Science earned
description: The Program has earned 2250 Science, and the world thinks of Mars as a place people have come to understand.
